name: patient_has_finding_of_hyperbilirubinemia_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has hyperbilirubinemia.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of hyperbilirubinemia.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of hyperbilirubinemia.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of hyperbilirubinemia.

name: patient_has_finding_of_hyperbilirubinemia_now@@low_risk
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current hyperbilirubinemia is low risk.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current hyperbilirubinemia is classified as low risk.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current hyperbilirubinemia is not classified as low risk.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's current hyperbilirubinemia is low risk.

name: patient_has_finding_of_hyperbilirubinemia_now@@requires_phototherapy
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current hyperbilirubinemia requires phototherapy.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current hyperbilirubinemia requires phototherapy.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current hyperbilirubinemia does not require phototherapy.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's current hyperbilirubinemia requires phototherapy.

name: patient_gestational_age_at_birth_value_recorded_in_weeks
meaning: Numeric value of the patient's gestational age at birth in completed weeks.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's gestational age at birth is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the numeric value of the patient's gestational age at birth in completed weeks as documented in the medical record.

name: patient_was_born_preterm_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient was born preterm (before 37 weeks gestational age).
when_true: Set to true if the patient was born preterm (before 37 weeks gestational age) as documented in the medical record.
when_false: Set to false if the patient was not born preterm (born at or after 37 weeks gestational age) as documented in the medical record.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's gestational age at birth is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_is_eligible_according_to_aap_guidelines_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient meets the AAP guidelines for phototherapy in low risk hyperbilirubinemia.
when_true: Set to true if the patient meets the American Academy of Pediatrics guidelines for phototherapy in low risk hyperbilirubinemia.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not meet the AAP guidelines for phototherapy in low risk hyperbilirubinemia.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient meets the AAP guidelines for phototherapy in low risk hyperbilirubinemia.

name: patient_is_eligible_according_to_kmc_program_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient meets the Kangaroo Mother Care Ambulatory Program recommendations for management of premature infants under 35 weeks.
when_true: Set to true if the patient meets the Kangaroo Mother Care Ambulatory Program recommendations for management of premature infants under 35 weeks.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not meet the KMC recommendations for management of premature infants under 35 weeks.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient meets the KMC recommendations for management of premature infants under 35 weeks.

name: patient_meets_combined_guidelines_for_phototherapy_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient meets both the AAP and KMC guidelines for phototherapy in low risk hyperbilirubinemia.
when_true: Set to true if the patient meets both the AAP guidelines and the Kangaroo Mother Care Ambulatory Program recommendations for phototherapy in low risk hyperbilirubinemia.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not meet both sets of guidelines.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient meets both sets of guidelines.

name: patient_has_finding_of_jaundice_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has jaundice.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of jaundice.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of jaundice.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of jaundice.

name: onset_of_jaundice_age_value_recorded_in_hours
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's chronological age in hours at the time of onset of jaundice.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's chronological age in hours at the time of onset of jaundice is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's chronological age in hours at the time jaundice first appeared, if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_onset_of_jaundice_at_age_greater_than_48_hours
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient had onset of jaundice at a chronological age greater than 48 hours.
when_true: Set to true if the patient had onset of jaundice at a chronological age greater than 48 hours.
when_false: Set to false if the patient had onset of jaundice at a chronological age of 48 hours or less.
when_unknown: Set to null if the age at onset of jaundice is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_has_finding_of_finding_of_blood_group_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a finding of blood group.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a finding of blood group documented (regardless of whose blood group).
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a finding of blood group documented.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a finding of blood group.

name: patient_has_finding_of_finding_of_blood_group_now@@blood_group_of_mother
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the blood group finding is that of the mother.
when_true: Set to true if the blood group finding refers specifically to the mother.
when_false: Set to false if the blood group finding does not refer to the mother.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the blood group finding refers to the mother.

name: patient_has_finding_of_finding_of_blood_group_now@@blood_group_of_child
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the blood group finding is that of the child.
when_true: Set to true if the blood group finding refers specifically to the child.
when_false: Set to false if the blood group finding does not refer to the child.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the blood group finding refers to the child.

name: parent_is_available_to_stay_in_kangaroo_mother_care_ambulatory_program
meaning: Boolean indicating whether at least one parent of the patient is available to stay in the Kangaroo Mother Care Ambulatory Program.
when_true: Set to true if at least one parent of the patient is available to stay in the Kangaroo Mother Care Ambulatory Program.
when_false: Set to false if no parent of the patient is available to stay in the Kangaroo Mother Care Ambulatory Program.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether any parent of the patient is available to stay in the Kangaroo Mother Care Ambulatory Program.

name: parent_total_hours_available_to_stay_in_kangaroo_mother_care_ambulatory_program_per_day
meaning: Numeric value indicating the total number of hours per day that at least one parent of the patient is available to stay in the Kangaroo Mother Care Ambulatory Program.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many hours per day at least one parent is available to stay in the Kangaroo Mother Care Ambulatory Program.
when_value: Set to the total number of hours per day that at least one parent of the patient is available to stay in the Kangaroo Mother Care Ambulatory Program.
